svg.title: C06-M05-F3: XSS contexts and the encoding fix
svg.desc: A diagram of reflected, stored and DOM XSS contexts with the shared fix of contextual output encoding, CSP and HttpOnly cookies.
svg.text: C06-M05-F3 XSS contexts and the encoding fix
reflected: /search?q=<script> -> echoed into response -> runs (via link)
stored: review body=<script> -> saved -> runs for every viewer
DOM: client JS writes input into page unsafely
fix: encode untrusted output for its context (html.escape) + CSP + HttpOnly
Figure C06-M05-F3. The three XSS contexts and the output-encoding (plus CSP) defence
